kypExtensions.summary: The null-value router and four-move interval-reading protocol: FIRST name the measure family, THEN fetch its null (mean difference -> 0 on the additive scale; OR/RR -> 1 on the multiplicative scale — both encode 'no effect'), THEN read the interval against it (excludes -> reject H0, significant; includes -> do not reject), with the two-group overlap variant (non-overlap -> significant; overlap -> not) and the precision question closing the loop (sample size narrows a single study's CI; a meta-analysis pools many studies).
kypExtensions.rationale: The source prints the six rules as parallel bullets but never states the routing step (which null value belongs to which measure family) nor the ordered reading protocol; the router and the four moves are KYP's synthesis of the printed rules.
kypExtensions.location: core.keyIdea + mechanisms[0] ci-significance-engine + blocks[3] the steps block + the visual's Zone B null-value router strip

kypExtensions.summary: The construction decoder for x ± Z(SE): the point estimate at the center, Z as the level-bought multiplier (1.96 at 95% / 2.58 at 99% — the 99% interval is the WIDER net), SE as the estimate's own wobble, and the printed narrowing rule explained (as sample size increases, CI narrows because SE shrinks — KYP: SE falls with the square root of n) plus the CI = 1 – α identity tying each level to its α.
kypExtensions.rationale: The source prints the formula, the constants, and the narrowing sentence as facts; the decomposition (which lever moves which end), the wider-not-better reading of 99%, and the √n explanation are KYP's.
kypExtensions.location: core.why + mechanisms[0] + blocks[2] the decoder list + the visual's Zone A formula card and number line

kypExtensions.summary: The bridge between the two printed blocks: pooling IS the narrowing rule scaled across studies — a meta-analysis behaves like the studies' combined sample, so its pooled CI is narrower than any single study's; plus the POOL / PRICE / POWER reading of the printed sentences (pools summary data; prices heterogeneity of effect sizes between studies; improves power, strength of evidence, and generalizability/external validity) and the 'garbage in, garbage out' gloss on the two printed limits (quality of individual studies; bias in study selection).
kypExtensions.rationale: The source prints the two blocks adjacently but never connects them; the dial-across-studies bridge, the three-verb reading, and the limits gloss are KYP's synthesis.
kypExtensions.location: core.why + mechanisms[1] meta-analysis-pooling-map + the visual's Zone C pooling diagram and bridge strip + rapidReview.m10

kypExtensions.summary: The pattern/trap/pivot/mini-case attack structure layered over the printed page — 4 patterns (the mean-difference CI excluding 0 stem, the RR CI including 1 'surprisingly negative' stem, the two-group overlap stem, the meta-analysis gains-and-limits stem), 4 traps (excludes 0 vs excludes 1; Z 1.96 vs 2.58; narrow-CI precision vs excludes-null significance; meta-analysis gains vs limits), 3 pivots (the null-value router, the two-interval overlap test, the one-study-vs-many-studies precision dial), and 8 recall cards covering every printed sentence.
kypExtensions.rationale: First Aid prints the definitions and rules only; the attack structure, distractor shapes, and reverse-direction questions are KYP's design.
